title: Pass a prop to a child
summary: Props are values a parent gives a child component.
introduction: Props are values a parent gives a child component. Your task: Pass a different title into BookCard.
learningObjectives: Pass a different title into BookCard.

blocks.text: Props are values a parent gives a child component. The child reads them to decide what to show.
Use a Vue 3 project made with the official create-vue tool. Put single-file examples in App.vue unless file names say otherwise. These need the Vue build tool and do not run in the plain playground.

blocks.title: Pass a prop to a child

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `defineProps` declares values supplied by a parent component. Treat those values as inputs.

blocks.text: The child card displays the title given by its parent.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Save the two parts as separate files. Treat props as inputs; do not change them directly in the child.
